name: Nitrous oxide
warning: Uses rhythmic pulsing/flicker. Photosensitivity note applies.
tierNotes: Threshold: one soft pulse as the envelope starts; barely a breath.
Light: gentle 2.5 Hz throb in scale and brightness.
Common: full wah-wah — real zoom-breathing throb + phase-picked frame echo + warm dimming mid-envelope.

Strong: deep throb, strong flanging, scintilla bursts at envelope peaks; double vision and frame-rate lag (stutter) wake up (late curves); a soft, blurred wall of organic interlocking-circle geometry breathes in with the envelope, bespoke to nitrous (not the shared pattern pass — it needs to pulse with the 2.5 Hz throb, which a static mask can't do).

Heavy: acuity suppression toward blindness at LFO peaks (blur pulse + whiteout stack), constant double vision, heavy frame lag, the geometry wall fully present and throbbing; the whole arc decays and restarts every ~25 s.
